historical_run.model: Not reported: neither the image-to-3d nor the rigging task response included a model field. ai_model was omitted, so the model stage used the API default.
historical_run.note: Two live runs, one per language, on September 25-26, 2026. Each consumed 30 credits (image-to-3d) + 5 credits (rigging), read from consumed_credits. Model stage 126-136 s from creation to finish; rigging 36-37 s. The Python run's rigging POST exceeded the client's former 60 s read timeout although the task was created; its ID was recovered from GET /openapi/v1/rigging and the run resumed. The TypeScript run lost DNS while polling the model and was resumed. Neither resume created a duplicate task.

artifact_inspection.method: Local file byte count and SHA-256; GLB JSON accessors and mesh/material/image/skin/animation arrays; joint names from skins[0].joints.
artifact_inspection.note: Python run artifacts (pictured). The TypeScript run produced 30,756 triangles, 34,158 vertices and the same 24-joint skeleton. All rigged files have 24 joints and one embedded base-color image. Walking loop 1.07 s, running loop 0.67 s. Model files are not published by this repository.
